provenance.title: Galileo 2 Extruder — real STEP assembly
provenance.author: JaredC01 and Galileo 2 contributors
provenance.licenseVersionNote: Upstream repository supplies the GNU GPL version 3 text; no additional or-later grant has been inferred.
provenance.derivatives: Original STEP is byte-identical. Any display mesh is a separately identified triangulated derivative; source products, usages and transforms are retained separately.
sourceNotes: The compact physical mechanism is a real Galileo 2 geared filament extruder, not a manufactured reference shaft bearing fixture.
The STEP source also contains its X carriage and a dummy PCB; the original full assembly is retained.
Carrier is the planetary carrier shaft. main_gear_g2 is the separate drive gear mounted on that shaft; no part identities have been inferred from appearance.
Fasteners contains 5 occurrences sharing the M3x20 SHCS definition and further repeated M3 screw definitions.
STEP placements are source data, not mates or validated joint constraints.

bearingHolder.role: Front support for MR148 shaft bearing

fasteners.note: The manual specifies two M3x8 SHCS for the front bearing holder and another M3x8 for the idler cover. Exact usage-to-hole association is left to source transforms, not names.

nativeSource.purpose: Upstream editable Fusion source accompanies the original STEP and derived display mesh; it is not claimed to be editable by the browser viewer.

limitations: IDs are stable for this exact source hash and importer version; re-exported source may renumber entities.
Face indices identify imported definition topology only, not persistent native feature IDs.
No source mate recovery, constraints, physical simulation, exact section, or interference API is implemented.
Self-contained STEP files with exact NAUO mapping are accepted; external references are disabled.
